description:
Where residents were born: counts and shares for the top 43 countries, plus Australia and other, in every suburb and council area.

Coverage: About 11,000 suburbs and localities and 545 council areas across Australia, in all states and territories (areas with too few residents for reliable figures are left out); one snapshot at 10 August 2021. Current to 2021-08-10. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/birthplace`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: total_population, australia_count, australia_pct, england_count, england_pct, india_count, india_pct, china_count, china_pct, new_zealand_count, new_zealand_pct, philippines_count, philippines_pct, vietnam_count, vietnam_pct, south_africa_count, south_africa_pct, malaysia_count, malaysia_pct, italy_count, italy_pct, sri_lanka_count, sri_lanka_pct, nepal_count, nepal_pct, scotland_count, scotland_pct, south_korea_count, south_korea_pct, united_states_count, united_states_pct, germany_count, germany_pct, hong_kong_count, hong_kong_pct, iraq_count, iraq_pct, greece_count, greece_pct, pakistan_count, pakistan_pct, lebanon_count, lebanon_pct, indonesia_count, indonesia_pct, thailand_count, thailand_pct, ireland_count, ireland_pct, iran_count, iran_pct, fiji_count, fiji_pct, netherlands_count, netherlands_pct, singapore_count, singapore_pct, afghanistan_count, afghanistan_pct, bangladesh_count, bangladesh_pct, canada_count, canada_pct, taiwan_count, taiwan_pct, brazil_count, brazil_pct, poland_count, poland_pct, japan_count, japan_pct, croatia_count, croatia_pct, egypt_count, egypt_pct, north_macedonia_count, north_macedonia_pct, zimbabwe_count, zimbabwe_pct, myanmar_count, myanmar_pct, cambodia_count, cambodia_pct, turkey_count, turkey_pct, france_count, france_pct, malta_count, malta_pct, not_stated_count, not_stated_pct, other_countries_count, other_countries_pct. Omit for all.

suburb_name.description: Suburb name exactly as /v1/suburbs/list returns it, e.g. `Bondi` or `St Kilda (Vic.)`.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.
